shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin consolidates near $84,000 amid resistance and positive ETF inflows.
Ethereum ETFs recorded $690 million in inflows as SEC clarified staking token rules.
Solana surged past $120, signaling a rotation into higher-beta altcoins.
Rising US Treasury yields and geopolitical tensions create macro headwinds and uncertainty.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index shows mixed sentiment, fluctuating between Neutral and Greed.
